coreComparison.method: First var hljs function expression core statements 0..39. TypeScript checker binds local variables/parameters/function/class/binding-element declarations, including function-expression names; only those symbols are normalized in first-use order. All token kinds, free globals, properties, literal and regex text are exact. Both final returns bind to the verified core instance. Upstream extra statements register common languages; local language fragments are separately verified.

packages.reviewedResolution: The actual exact-package LICENSE grants WTFPL version 2 permission; npm MIT metadata is not relied on. Original author/copyright and full license text retained. Lead explicitly reviewed this free/open distribution grant.

localModification.description: Original GDScript(e) function is renamed r(e); grammar function body and parameter remain token-identical.
